games.toml:
id = "reversi"
title = "黑白棋"
description = "两人在 8×8 棋盘上轮流落子，夹住的对方棋子翻成自己的颜色。无处可下时自动跳过，终局子多者胜。非法落子或崩溃判负。"
min_players = 2
max_players = 2
turn_timeout_ms = 1000
max_turns = 64
max_faults = 0

[config]
size = 8

[render]
kind = "grid"
width = 8
height = 8
background = "felt"
fps = 3

[render.cells.1]
shape = "stone"
player = 0

[render.cells.2]
shape = "stone"
player = 1

[input]
kind = "cell"

bots.name: corner.py
corner.rs
Edge.java
greedy.js
mobility.cpp
weights.c

games.toml:
id = "snake"
title = "贪吃蛇"
description = "1 到 6 条蛇同时移动。吃果子变长得分，撞墙、撞到任何蛇身就出局。活得久、吃得多的排名靠前。一个人也能玩，比谁的分高。"
min_players = 1
max_players = 6
turn_timeout_ms = 300
max_turns = 400
max_faults = 5

[config]
width = 24
height = 18
food = 6
start_length = 3

[render]
kind = "grid"
width = 24
height = 18
background = "plain"
fps = 10

[render.sprites.food]
shape = "dot"
color = "#e0563f"
size = 0.6

[render.sprites.body]
shape = "square"
size = 0.86

[render.sprites.head]
shape = "head"
size = 1.0

[input]
kind = "keys"
tick_ms = 220

[input.keys]
ArrowUp = { dir = 0 }
ArrowRight = { dir = 1 }
ArrowDown = { dir = 2 }
ArrowLeft = { dir = 3 }

bots.name: bfs.py
Careful.java
flood.cpp
nearest.c
roomy.rs
space.js

games.toml:
id = "maze"
title = "迷宫拾光"
description = "1 到 4 个探索者在随机迷宫里同时行动，收集光点得分，躲开巡逻的哨兵。拿到护盾后可以反过来击退哨兵。看不到太远的对手和哨兵。"
min_players = 1
max_players = 4
turn_timeout_ms = 300
max_turns = 300
max_faults = 5

[config]
width = 21
height = 15
sentries = 3
shields = 4
shield_turns = 20
sight = 7
lives = 2

[render]
kind = "grid"
width = 21
height = 15
background = "plain"
fps = 8

[render.cells.1]
shape = "wall"

[render.cells.2]
shape = "dot"
size = 0.26
color = "#2f9e8f"

[render.cells.3]
shape = "ring"
size = 0.62
color = "#c9861c"

[render.sprites.runner]
shape = "hex"
size = 0.84

[render.sprites.shielded]
shape = "hex_shield"
size = 0.84

[render.sprites.sentry]
shape = "diamond"
size = 0.8
color = "#4b5563"

[render.sprites.sentry_scared]
shape = "diamond"
size = 0.62
color = "#9aa8bd"

[input]
kind = "keys"
tick_ms = 260

[input.keys]
ArrowUp = { dir = 0 }
ArrowRight = { dir = 1 }
ArrowDown = { dir = 2 }
ArrowLeft = { dir = 3 }
Space = { dir = 4 }

bots.name: bfs.c
finder.rs
light.py
runner.js
Seeker.java
wary.cpp
